about_short_description.short_description: Strella is a Software as a Service (SaaS) solution that allows innovative product teams to run fast, continuous user research using AI.

product.name: AI-Generated Interview Guide
product.description: Generates customized interview guides based on research objectives, designed to reduce bias and tailored to specific environments.

product.name: AI-Moderated Interviews
product.description: Conducts interviews moderated by AI that dynamically adjusts questions based on participant responses, supporting multiple languages and unlimited scale.

product.name: Global Participant Recruitment
product.description: Provides access to a global panel of over 3 million participants for user research studies, including recruitment, incentives, and scheduling.

product.name: Real-Time Interview Analysis and Synthesis
product.description: Analyzes interviews in real time, providing insights, verbatim highlights, and customizable reports aligned with research goals.

product.name: Multimedia Stimuli Embedding and Recording
product.description: Allows embedding of various stimuli (websites, prototypes, images, videos, ad copy) with screen and video recording to capture participant interactions.

product.name: Research Repository and Data Management
product.description: Stores all interview recordings and data, both AI and human-moderated, for easy access, sharing, and querying across teams.
